coverage: Cross-visit reuse of a recorded measurement with provenance (slice R33, BR-DATA-12): reusedMeasurement copying the value field(s) and the effective source and observation time (per-measurement and visit-level fallback), dropping stale entered-unit and unusual-value reasons, and the reuseFact command (care role, stale version, self and cross-person source, imported read-only source, non-confirmed source and unrecorded measurement refusals; an open dispute on the measurement blocking reuse while a resolved dispute or a dispute on another measurement does not; a successful reuse carrying value and provenance forward, bumping the visit version and writing the audit event; the strict schema).
